subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should #43117 expand beyond the shipped image/audio extraPaths subset to PDF/video files and remembered inbound media attachments, and what consent/retention/provider contract should govern that?
rationale: The remaining request changes public memory modality config and may upload or retain richer user media through a remote embedding provider, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design first, then split scope
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, approve a short design for media consent/retention/provider limits, then split PDF/video and inbound-attachment indexing into narrower implementation issues.

options.title: Keep extraPaths-only for now
options.body: Close or narrow the issue to the shipped image/audio extraPaths behavior and direct users to explicit file-based memory rather than automatic attachment memory.

options.title: Approve broad media memory
options.body: Allow PDF/video and remembered inbound attachments as core memory behavior with tests, docs, live provider proof, and a security review before merge.

recommendation.title: Design first, then split scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker, approve a short design for media consent/retention/provider limits, then split PDF/video and inbound-attachment indexing into narrower implementation issues.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history signal for the current multimodal memory indexing foundation.
